newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-ROBERTO ALOMAR OUT FOUR WEEKS WITH ANKLE INJURY.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-ROBERTO ALOMAR OUT FOUR WEEKS WITH ANKLE INJURY.

text.p: Baltimore Orioles second baseman Roberto Alomar will be sidelined for approximately four weeks with a left ankle injury, the team confirmed on Wednesday.

Results of an MRI performed Tuesday revealed a severe sprain and a slight chip, or flake, of a bone in the left ankle, the team physician said adding that Alomar would be examined again in three weeks.

Alomar had his ankle in a splint and was walking with the aid of crutches after arriving at the Orioles' spring training facility last weekend. Alomar said he aggravated a previous injury playing in a charity basketball game in his native Puerto Rico last week.
Alomar must serve a five-game suspension at the start of the season for spitting in the face of umpire John Hirschbeck during a game in Toronto last September 26.
The slick-fielding second baseman hit .328 with 22 homers and 94 RBI and was named to the American League All-Star team last season.
